warning.titleHighlight: (TDV6, SDV6, TDV8, SDV8, or Si6 I6)
paragraphs: The TDV6, SDV6, TDV8, SDV8, or Si6 is a sophisticated 3.0-litre inline-six with an integrated starter-generator and electric auxiliary compressor — a more modern and efficient design than the older TDV6, SDV6, TDV8, SDV8, or Si6 V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every TDV6, SDV6, TDV8, SDV8, or Si6 rebuild.
Because the Discovery HSE uses a completely different engine family from the V8 M178 fitted to the Discovery 63 and GT 63 S, parts and rebuild specifications don't cross over between them.
warning.source: Source: Established TDV6, SDV6, TDV8, SDV8, or Si6 specialist pattern — timing chain, bearing and gasket wear across integrated-starter-generator inline-six units.
